title: Can you integrate the residual sensor for the source 640G? For Master/Follower Pump Status ?
body:
Hello developer,

Have me with other 640 G users entertained, and there came the question whether it is possible in the pump status to show the remaining time of the sensor? Or does it have to change the Android NS Uploader for such data? Thanks already for their efforts and a possible response.

Best greetings

by Matthias
